senses.gloss: m. (בִּין, cmp. בַּיִן) a thin thing, hair; ב׳ דמיא (cmp. נִימָא) leech. Pl. בִּינֵי.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 69b:11">Gitt. 69ᵇ</cite>. [<cite ref="Shabbat 67a:1">Sabb. 67ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="B00655"><he>בִּינְתָא</he></cite> I a. II.] Cmp. <cite ref="B00650"><he>בִּינִיתָא</he></cite>.
